text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Alrighty☆ Time for another concert—hm?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Urara~♪ Ura-ura-ura~♪ U-ra-ra-!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan! What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Falco-san! Just now, I was trying to 
imitate you, Falco-san!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Because I wanna become just like 
Falco-san!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh! Really?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because Falco-san is super fast, and 
really great at singing and dancing, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If I copy Falco-san, I'm sure I can take 
1st place and dance great in the center 
position too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And so~, Ura-ura~♪ U-u-Urara~n♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh...! Falco finally has a 
follower... ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan! If that's the case... Falco 
will give you some Umadol lessons!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
From the underground to the surface, from 
turf to dirt... Everything Falco has 
cultivated from venue to venue! I'm gonna 
pour it all in without holding back!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but it sounds fun! 
Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: —Ready, set, Uraran!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uraran!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ura-ura?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ura-ura!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ura-ura, ura-ura—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara~n♪ My favorites are everyone 
and carrots! Aiming for 1st place! It's 
Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Nice, looking good, Urara-chan! Next 
time, make it even more *sparkly☆*!"
